title: FairMonitor: A Four-Stage Automatic Framework for Detecting Stereotypes and Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a four-stage open-ended question framework in educational scenarios: direct inquiry testing, adapted story testing (comparing LLM outputs when sensitive traits are modified), implicit association testing via paired questions, and unknown situation testing (projecting the bias into novel contexts like a space colony).
